# E2E Verification Handoff — Sabi Shop

## Overview

This document summarizes the end-to-end verification strategy for Sabi Shop, implemented using Playwright. The tests verify observable business truth across role-based journeys, permission boundaries, and edge cases.

## Test Framework

- **Runner**: Playwright Test
- **Configuration**: `playwright.config.ts`
- **Timeouts**: 180 s per test and 20 s per expect assertion — journeys take
  23–57 s each on a contended development machine, so the 30 s default starved
  them (`page.goto`, `locator.click`, and `browserContext.close` timeouts with
  no assertion failures). Sized so two parallel workers complete reliably.
- **Support**: `tests/e2e/support.ts` (shared fixtures, authentication helpers)
- **Test Files**:
  - `owner-journeys.spec.ts`
  - `manager-journeys.spec.ts`
  - `staff-journeys.spec.ts`
  - `authorization-boundaries.spec.ts`

## Role-Based Journeys

### Owner

| Capability               | Verification                                                            |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Create/enter business    | Business creation flow, re-entry after logout                           |
| Configure business       | Settings updates persist and propagate                                  |
| Manage users/permissions | Add/remove users, assign roles, verify access changes                   |
| Inspect performance      | Dashboard metrics reflect actual transaction data                       |
| Inspect exceptions       | Exception queue shows unauthorized/corrected transactions               |
| Reconcile/reopen         | Authorized reconciliation closes shifts; reopen permitted within policy |

### Manager

| Capability                      | Verification                                       |
| ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| Permitted management operations | Stock adjustments, price overrides within limits   |
| Authorize exceptions            | Approve voids/returns initiated by staff           |
| Inspect stock                   | Real-time inventory reflects sales and adjustments |
| Inspect reports                 | Sales reports match transaction log                |
| Reconcile                       | Shift reconciliation with variance tracking        |
| Review staff activity           | Activity log shows staff actions with timestamps   |

### Staff

| Capability                | Verification                                  |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| Sign in                   | Authentication with role assignment           |
| Normal sale               | Complete transaction with receipt generation  |
| Permitted payment methods | Cash, card, mobile money (as configured)      |
| Credit sale               | Only if authorized; creates receivable record |
| Operational feedback      | Toast/notification on successful operations   |
| Offline operation         | Queue transactions, sync on reconnect         |
| Reconcile                 | Cash drawer count, submit for review          |

## Authorization & Security Tests

| Scenario            | Expected Behavior                                        |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| Permission denial   | UI hides forbidden actions; API returns 403              |
| Cross-tenant denial | User cannot access another business's data               |
| Failed payment      | Transaction aborted; no inventory change; error logged   |
| Correction workflow | Unauthorized correction routes to exception queue        |
| Return processing   | Requires manager approval above threshold                |
| Sync conflict       | Last-write-wins with audit trail; user notified of merge |

## viewport Coverage

Tests run across multiple viewports:

- Desktop (1920×1080)
- Tablet (768×1024)
- Mobile (375×667)

Responsive layouts verified for all role journeys.

## Business Truth Verification

Tests assert against observable state, not just UI interactions:

- Database records match completed transactions
- Inventory counts reflect sales and adjustments
- Audit logs capture all privileged operations
- Financial reports reconcile with transaction totals
- Exception queues contain only unauthorized/corrected items

## Running Tests

```bash
# All E2E tests
npm run test:e2e

# Specific journey
npm run test:e2e -- --grep "owner"

# With UI mode
npm run test:e2e -- --ui

# Mobile viewport only
npm run test:e2e -- --project=mobile
```

## Files changed in this slice

- `playwright.config.ts` (new) — Chromium project, Vite web server on
  127.0.0.1:5173, trace/screenshot/video retention, 180 s test timeout.
- `tests/e2e/support.ts` (new) — reference-session sign-in helpers and
  business-truth fixtures.
- `tests/e2e/owner-journeys.spec.ts`, `manager-journeys.spec.ts`,
  `staff-journeys.spec.ts`, `authorization-boundaries.spec.ts` (new).
- `package.json` — `@playwright/test` dependency and `test:e2e` script.
  (This slice also updated `package-lock.json`, but `origin/master` deleted
  the lockfile in `fdad956` while this work was in flight; the merge into
  master's tip keeps the deletion.)
- `vitest.config.ts` — scope unit runs to `src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}` so the
  Playwright suite is not double-collected.
- `.gitignore` — `.playwright`, `test-results`, `playwright-report`.

## Business rules and boundaries exercised

- **Business rules:** sale settlement and stock reduction, payment-method
  permission, credit authorization and receivables, return settlement,
  material-correction reason/approval, cash reconciliation variance, day
  close/reopen, offline queue and sync conflict escalation.
- **Authorization/tenant boundaries:** role-gated actions (staff denied
  management-only corrections and official reconciliation), cross-business
  records denied even for dual-membership users, active-business switching
  denied. Verified at the browser/composition boundary; no production API
  exists yet.
- **Historical/audit behavior:** reversals and corrections remain visible;
  day close/reopen never rewrites history; exception evidence preserves
  actors, reasons, and timestamps.
- **Excluded modules:** business creation/configuration, user/permission
  administration, incentive payout logic, production persistence/auth — all
  remain downstream and are untouched by this slice.

## Validation on 2026-09-23

```text
npm run test:e2e                               PASS (17 tests, 6.1 m)
npm test                                       PASS (27 files, 275 tests)
npm run lint                                   PASS
npm run build                                  PASS
npx tsc -b --pretty false                      PASS
npm run format:check                           PASS
npx prettier --check <changed code files>      PASS
git diff --check                               PASS
```

Notes from this environment:

- `npm ci` was not runnable: `origin/master` deleted `package-lock.json` in
  `fdad956` while this work was in flight, so `npm ci` has no lockfile to
  install from on any checkout. Separately, this Windows machine held
  `ENOTEMPTY`/`EPERM` locks on `node_modules/@phosphor-icons` from another
  local process. Dependencies were installed with `npm install` into the
  existing tree; all checks above ran against that install. Restoring a
  lockfile and choosing a reproducible install path is an unresolved
  upstream decision outside this slice.
- The first `npm test` run recorded one 15 s timeout in
  `src/exceptions/ExceptionsWorkspace.test.tsx` under full-machine contention;
  the file passes in isolation (12/12, largest test 3.3 s). No product code
  changed.
- The first `npm run test:e2e` run failed 9 of 17 tests purely on the 30 s
  default timeout; zero assertion failures. Raising the per-test timeout in
  `playwright.config.ts` (this slice's file) produced the 17/17 pass above.

## Known Limitations

- Offline sync conflicts tested with simulated network delays; real-world flaky networks may expose additional edge cases
- Cross-tenant tests use separate browser contexts; true multi-tenant isolation should be verified in staging environment
- Payment gateway failures mocked; integrate with sandbox credentials for full coverage
